1.name: Kit Tries to Ground Yuul
1.description: Kit pulls Yuul aside, trying to steady her with humor or ritual. Yuul responds with slight delay.

1.name: Someone Notices
1.description: A stranger studies them too closely: 'You look hollow.'

1.name: Rielle's Impulse
1.description: Rielle acts on sudden instinct. It half-works.

1.name: Grace Moment
1.description: A beautiful moment--a laugh, shared silence, sunrise.

1.name: Bonfire Night
1.description: Their last truly safe moment around a fire.

1.name: Farris Senses Something
1.description: Farris tenses. His eyes track something no one else sees.

1.name: Daniel Asks the Wrong Questions
1.description: Daniel presses for details they can't give. Pressure mounts.

2.name: Kit, Desperate Protector
2.description: Kit steps between danger and the group. Again. It costs him.

2.name: Maeve Spirals
2.description: The pattern pulls at her. She can't look away.

2.name: Internal Suspicion
2.description: Someone in the group questions Yuul's visions. Bonds strain.

2.name: Brief Reprieve
2.description: A quiet moment. No one screams, dissolves, or bleeds.

2.name: Unexpected Kindness
2.description: A stranger returns a kindness. Not everything hunts them.

2.name: He Sees the Thing Before It Moves
2.description: Farris senses a threat before it breaches. He saves them by seconds.

2.name: Real Intel: Daniel Delivers
2.description: Daniel arrives with actual intel--coordinates, names, weak points.

2.name: H11 Pressure Spike
2.description: The Directorate tightens its grip. Someone has to answer.

3.name: The First Warning Returns
3.description: Yuul grabs Maeve's wrist--eyes glassy, speech inverted. A second warning.

3.name: Kit Breaks
3.description: The protector finally fractures. He can't hold anymore.

3.name: Maeve's True Insight
3.description: She sees the pattern completely. It sees her back.

3.name: Redchurch Prelude
3.description: The structure hums. They're all standing at the threshold.

3.name: The Door That Breathes
3.description: The Sanctuary door exhales. Wood ripples like skin. A crossing point forms.

3.name: The Name That Wants to Live
3.description: Maeve hears the hidden name--the one beneath the Pattern, the one she never dared to claim.

3.name: He Breaks Through the Threshold
3.description: The boundary weakens. Farris tears through it to pull someone back.

3.name: Structural Override: Daniel's Rewrite
3.description: Daniel overrides a Directorate protocol. Reality rewrites for one glorious second.

3.name: The List Manifests
3.description: The List isn't a metaphor anymore. It's here. Hungry.
